issue_context.title: Can not remove constructor parentheses when using optional chaining after constructor.
issue_context.body:

review_comments:
It's possible to write `new Date()?.toLocaleDateString()`. 
But `new Date?.()` is invalid and will be caught by the parse/lint stage.
I think we can use `debug_assert` in such cases, we have the same situation in CSS codege - in theory developer can modify AST and create invalid code
